content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Secondary safety endpoint lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "AEs, serious adverse events (SAEs), and AEs leading to discontinuation or death, and severity of AEs as assessed by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The safety endpoint is listed but no specific statistical analysis method is described for it in the statistical methods section; only general safety assessments are mentioned.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed analysis description for safety endpoints (e.g., incidence rates, severity grading summaries) in Section 9.6."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint lacks a formal hypothesis test description",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of the study is the ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on RECIST v1.1 as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR).",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.1 Primary Endpoint",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint is defined but the statistical section does not explicitly state the hypothesis test (e.g., exact binomial test) for the primary analysis, only the sample size calculation mentions it.",
      "fix": "Explicitly describe the primary analysis method (e.g., one-sample exact binomial test) and corresponding hypothesis in Section 9.5."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on RECIST v1.1 as determined by BICR.",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.1 Primary Endpoint",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is incomplete: it does not specify the population (ITT is mentioned later but not tied here), the intercurrent events strategy (e.g., how to handle death or treatment discontinuation), or the summary measure (proportion is implied but not formally stated).",
      "fix": "Define the estimand attributes for the primary endpoint, including population, intercurrent events handling, and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for PK endpoint",
      "quote": "Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK endpoint is listed but no corresponding statistical analysis is described in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add a PK analysis subsection describing how PK parameters will be derived and summarized."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for immunogenicity endpoint",
      "quote": "Development of anti-Qb antibodies",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity endpoint is listed but no analysis method is provided in the statistical section.",
      "fix": "Add an immunogenicity analysis subsection describing how anti-Qb antibody data will be summarized and analyzed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for exploratory biomarker endpoints",
      "quote": "Baseline, and change from Baseline, in tumor or blood measurements of biomarkers related to TLR9, immune checkpoints, and potential markers of resistance or response to immunotherapy",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory biomarker endpoints are listed but no statistical analysis is described for them in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add an exploratory biomarker analysis subsection describing how these endpoints will be analyzed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for CXCL10/cytokine endpoint",
      "quote": "Change from Baseline in blood concentrations of CXCL10 (interferon gamma-induced protein 10) and other cytokines after treatment with CMP-001",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The cytokine endpoint is listed but no statistical analysis is described for it.",
      "fix": "Add an analysis description for the CXCL10/cytokine endpoint in the statistical methods."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inconsistency: 69 vs 100 subjects",
      "quote": "A sample size of 69 subjects achieves at least 90% power to detect a difference of 13% using a 2-sided exact test with a significance level of 0.05, assuming that the null hypothesis for ORR is 7% (Hodi-2016; Ribas-2018), and the study ORR is 20%. The sample size was increased to 100 subjects to adjust for an early discontinuation rate of 15% and to allow for a robust assessment of safety.",
      "page": 80,
      "section": "9.1 Sample Size Calculation",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The sample size calculation is based on 69 subjects, but the study enrolls 100. The text explains the increase, but the primary power calculation is not directly tied to the final sample size; this may be acceptable but could be clarified.",
      "fix": "Clarify that the power calculation is based on the evaluable population and that the 100 subjects account for attrition, or provide a power calculation for the full sample size."
    }
  ]
}
